title: Haze: survival when Smoke Bomb is silenced/stunned or her healing is cut
question: A2: how much survival is lost when the enemy silences or stuns her before smoke, or applies anti-heal, and which remedy (Unstoppable pre-pop, Vampiric Burst as an item heal, Leech) recovers most?
hypothesis: Model: without smoke she dies 2-2.6 s sooner when focused at 10-24k and dies at 6.6 s instead of living at 41.6k+.
controls: hardreset between blocks (fresh pawns, factory cooldowns/charges, unlock 7 = all 3 tiers on every ability in BOTH arms)
Same position (fetch 350, aimoff 5.5 3), same enemy bot (Haze), egod default floor
Arms interleaved A,B,A,B (counterbalanced A,B,B,A for the second half)
healreset + mark none around every reset
cast reload 2.5 before each fire block (no auto-reload op)
procedure: incoming gun 2x reference dps; fight 12 s; record time of first HP <= 3% (lowhp floor) or HP at end

decision.rule: Only the 'smoke not cast' proxy is runnable; real silence/stun (ecc), anti-heal on the player (eheal) and enemy fire are UNSUPPORTED.

limitations: Checkpoint level/ability-tier states cannot be reproduced (unlock sets all tiers; GAPS #2): results are late-game relative comparisons only.
`incoming` is a smooth stream; the safety 'heal to full below 15%' is disabled by incoming.
